name: PDS 453
notes: Highly inclined (~80°) 'grazing angle' icy disk; bright central point source is a forward-scattering glint through the upper disk layer. Water-ice band at 3.1 µm (Subaru/IRCS, [Terada & Tokunaga 2017](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.01055)). Disk first identified by Perrin 2006 (Lick/IRCAL), resolved by HST/NICMOS ([Perrin+2010](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010ApJ...707L.132P/abstract)).

images.wavelength_label: BB_H polarized intensity; sharpest image of the disk to date
